name: Minas Basin Trail
why: One of the park's two trails from the parking lot to the Cape Split Lookoff at the tip: 6.2 km one way (about 2 hours), so 12.4 km out and back.

name: Scots Bay Trail
why: The park's other trail to the Cape Split Lookoff, along the Scots Bay side: 7 km one way (about 2 h 10 min), so 14 km out and back.
